usage: Refers to a television set or TV as a household device. It is a very common everyday noun in spoken Hong Kong Cantonese.
Often used with verbs like 睇, 開, 買, or 收音? No — for TV, common collocations are 睇電視, 開電視, 熄電視, 買電視.
Can also mean television as a medium or broadcast format, depending on context, so the same word may cover both the device and the platform.
Neutral and very common in daily speech. For a TV channel, people often say 電視台 instead of using 電視 alone.
